homepage.pageDescription: Runway is building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world. We offer products and services built on-top of this intelligence to empower individuals and organizations to do more in the world.
homepage.heroTitle: Building AI to <br class='hidden lg:block'/> Simulate the World
homepage.heroSocialProof: Used by 60M+ users globally - try today and cancel anytime
homepage.partnersLabel: We partner with the world's leading organizations to advance their industries:
homepage.researchDescription: We are building foundational General World Models that will be capable of simulating all possible worlds and experiences. The next frontier of intelligence will come from models that can understand, perceive, generate and act in the world.
homepage.gwm1ResearchDesc: A state-of-the-art General World Model built to interact with the real world. And a major step towards universal simulation.
homepage.gen45ResearchDesc: The world's best video model, featuring state-of-the-art motion quality, prompt adherence and visual fidelity.
homepage.gwmResearchDesc: Our long-term research effort to build AI systems that understand the visual world and its dynamics.
homepage.gwm1Paragraph1: GWM-1: our state-of-the-art General World Model, built to simulate reality in real time. Interactive, controllable and general-purpose.
homepage.gwm1Paragraph2: GWM-1 comes in three variants: GWM Worlds for explorable environments, GWM Avatars for conversational characters, and GWM Robotics for robotic manipulation.
homepage.gen45Headline: Gen-4.5: A new frontier for video generation.
homepage.gen45Description: Runway Gen-4.5 is the world's top-rated video model, offering unprecedented visual fidelity and creative control. It produces cinematic and highly realistic outputs while providing limitless creative freedom and precise control over every aspect of generation.
homepage.industriesHeading: Runway is being used by the world's leading organizations across industries
homepage.nvidiaTitle: Runway and NVIDIA Partner to Advance Video Generation and World Models
homepage.nvidiaDesc: Runway and NVIDIA collaborated to accelerate Runway's video and world models with NVIDIA's Vera Rubin architecture.
homepage.lionsgateDesc: Runway and Lionsgate are partnering to explore the use of AI in film production.
homepage.uclaTitle: UCLA's Department of Film, Television and Digital Media
homepage.uclaDesc: How UCLA's Film, Television and Digital Media program empowers students to experiment with AI in filmmaking.
homepage.kpfTitle: How KPF is incorporating AI into Architectural workflows
homepage.kpfDesc: How KPF is using Runway to streamline rendering workflows and empower creatives to animate architectural projects in-house.
homepage.ctaBuildingAi: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.
homepage.ctaJoinTeam: Join our global team of researchers, engineers, artists and designers.
homepage.aiChangingHeading: AI is changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.
homepage.gen45CardSubtitle: A New Frontier for Video Generation
homepage.gen45CardTitle: Gen-4.5: A New Frontier for Generative Video
homepage.gen45CardDesc: Gen-4.5 is the world's best video model, featuring state-of-the-art motion quality, prompt adherence and visual fidelity.
homepage.roboticsCardTitle: GWM Robotics: General World Models for Robotics
homepage.roboticsCardDesc: Simulate physical interactions and robotic behaviors through learned world models. Learn and predict how actions unfold.
homepage.worldsCardTitle: GWM Worlds: Interactive and Explorable World Models
homepage.worldsCardDesc: A new frontier for open-ended interactive world simulation. A way of building infinite explorable realities in real-time.
homepage.avatarsCardDesc: Fully autonomous and real-time virtual video agents capable of natural conversation and contextual awareness.
homepage.thirdPartyTitle: Every model you need to make anything you want.
homepage.charactersParagraph1: A real-time video agent API that lets you build fully custom conversational characters. These video agents can have any appearance and any visual style, with full control over voice, personality, knowledge and actions.
homepage.charactersParagraph2: Built on our recently launched world model, GWM-1, Characters lets you generate expressive digital personas from a single image, with zero fine-tuning required.
homepage.rwiHeroDescription: Runway is building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world. We offer products and services built on-top of this intelligence to empower individuals and organizations to do more in the world.
homepage.rwiHeroTitleB: Intelligent tools for scaling <break></break>content and teams.
homepage.rwiHeroDescriptionB: Runway is building foundational Real-World Intelligence that is changing how the world’s top brands, companies, agencies and studios are able to tell their stories.
homepage.platformsHeading: Three platforms built on-top of the same Real-World Intelligence models
homepage.platformCreativeTagline: Your complete Creative Suite with everything you need, to make anything you want.
homepage.platformCreativeBody: An all-in-one cloud-based creative platform that offers endless ways to generate and edit video, images and audio in one workspace. Built for individuals and teams of all sizes.
homepage.platformCreativeFootnote: Used by 60m+ creatives around the world. Try free, cancel anytime.
homepage.platformDevTagline: The AI media platform for developers to build with the best models from Runway and other labs.
homepage.platformDevBody: The API platform with Runway's expertise built in. Access the best models and the creative tooling to easily get production-ready output from them, at scale.
homepage.platformRoboticsTagline: A complete toolkit to run policy inference through photorealistic simulation.
homepage.platformRoboticsBody: From policy inference and evaluation to synthetic data generation, every component is powered by GWM-1, our state-of-the-art General World Model. Pick the surface you need — we'll work with you to fit it to your hardware.
homepage.devSectionDescription: Create your own pipelines combining multiple models, modalities and tasks. Trigger Workflows via custom endpoints.
homepage.devBullet2: Get dedicated support from Runway's Technical Artists for Workflow builds
homepage.devTabRecipesDesc: Pre-built endpoints for specific use cases. Get professional-quality assets with one request.
homepage.devTabCharactersDesc: Build expressive characters with custom voices, knowledge and tools, ready for live interaction directly from your product.
homepage.recipeProductAdDesc: Generate ad videos from a product photo. Ready for social, ecommerce or paid placements.
homepage.recipeProductUgcDesc: Generate vertical user-generated content ads from a character photo, product photo, and creative brief.
homepage.recipeProductSwapDesc: Replace the product in an existing ad video with a new product while preserving camera motion and scene composition.
homepage.recipeMultiShotVideoDesc: Generate a multi-cut video from a story prompt or custom shot list with cohesive cinematic pacing.
homepage.recipeMarketingStockImageDesc: Generate polished, on-brand marketing stock imagery from a text brief and an optional reference image of brand assets.
homepage.recipeProductCampaignImageDesc: Generate four fashion campaign images from a product photo and creative brief.
homepage.runwayAdsDesc: An autonomous engine for performance marketing that generates, localizes, publishes and iterates on ad creative, with human approval built in.
homepage.praxis1Desc: An open-weight world action model that turns Runway's video pretraining into control for real robots.
homepage.openaiMarketplaceDesc: Runway is a launch partner in the OpenAI Marketplace, so enterprise teams can bring Runway and models from other labs into one workspace.
homepage.claudeMotionDesc: Export animated explainers from Claude Motion to Runway. Generate footage, add voiceover and music, edit scene by scene and reformat for every channel.
homepage.gwmWorlds2Desc: GWM Worlds 2 generates interactive worlds in real time: continuous 720p video at 24 fps and audio at 48,000 Hz, responding to your inputs as you explore.

robotics.toolkitHeading: A complete toolkit for robot learning.
robotics.toolkitIntro: From policy inference and evaluation to synthetic data generation, every component is powered by GWM-1, our state-of-the-art General World Model. Pick the surface you need — we'll work with you to fit it to your hardware.
robotics.policyModelDesc: Control your robot with Runway's General World Model. GWM-1 predicts actions from live observations — custom fine-tuned for your specific hardware, environment, and tasks.
robotics.videoLicensingDesc: License GWM-1 as the diffusion backbone for training custom policy models. Deploy on your own infrastructure with full control over fine-tuning.
robotics.policyEvalDesc: Submit action sequences and camera observations to simulate policy rollouts in GWM-1. Surface failure modes before deploying to hardware.
robotics.dataAugDesc: Transform existing trajectories into new environments, lighting conditions, and object configurations. Expand your training distribution without collecting more data.

contact.pageTitle: Contact Runway Robotics | Get in touch
contact.pageDescription: Get in touch with the Runway Robotics team about bringing Runway's models to your robot learning pipeline — policy inference, evaluation, data augmentation, and video model licensing.
